orc: Grukk's cousin said this place will do.
elf: A quiet corner, if any remain.
The night air follows me in.
dwarf: By me beard, it's cold out there.
halfling: Is it supper time? It's supper time.
goblin: Nobody look at me. I'm buyin', I'm buyin'!
undead: The cold does not bother me. I brought it.

human: A mug of your best, keeper.
Ale, and whatever's in the pot.
orc: Bring drink before I get thirsty. Too late. HURRY.
elf: The nettle wine. Chilled, if this establishment can manage.
dwarf: Ale! And keep the next one ready.
One ale now, one ale soon.
halfling: Cakes! And maybe stew. And maybe both.
One of everything that's food, please.
goblin: Mead! The cheap kind. Wait, what's the EXPENSIVE kind cost?
undead: Wine. It reminds me of... something.
Pour. I shall remember drinking fondly.

human: Service is slower than the mill queue.
orc: ORC IS WAITING. ORC HATES WAITING.
I count to ten. I know six numbers.
elf: I have watched forests grow faster.
Patience is a virtue. Mine is thinning.
dwarf: A dwarf could dig a well faster than this.
halfling: My tummy is making the angry noise.
goblin: Tick tock, tick tock, gimme gimme.
Slow service means discount, yes? YES?
undead: I have waited longer. In the ground.
Time means little. Yet this is absurd.

orc: Mug small. Orc forgives. This time.
halfling: Look at it. Just look at it!
goblin: Heh heh. Nobody else touches it.
undead: A small warmth in a long night.

human: I'll be telling folk about this place.
elf: Perhaps I shall return within the decade.
dwarf: Finest pour this side o' the mountain!
halfling: That was perfect. What's for dessert?
Five stars. Would eat again. WILL eat again.
goblin: Good stuff! Shame about the price. Heh.

default: I've had better service in a ditch!
human: The inn down the road pours faster!
elf: I shall not dignify this with anger. I am leaving.
halfling: I am VERY cross and also STILL hungry!
This is worse than the year without jam!
goblin: You lose customer! And maybe spoons!

elf: Your presence curdles the wine, brute.
dwarf: Watch yer elbows, ya green oaf!
That's MY table, ya wee menace!
halfling: I— I know a guy! A big guy!
You leave my supper out of this!
undead: Do not test what cannot die.
I have buried better men than you. Personally.

human: Home before the wife notices. Cheers!
orc: ORC GO NOW. TAVERN SURVIVES. GOOD JOB.
dwarf: Back to the forge. Worse luck.
Save me stool. It knows me now.
halfling: Time to walk it off. Slowly. Toward more food.
goblin: Leaving! Check your pockets later! I mean— bye!

orc: TO BLOOD, MEAD, AND THIS FINE SHED! WAAAGH!
RAISE MUGS OR RAISE FISTS! WAAAGH!

human: Did you hear about the miller's cow? Whole thing. Gone.
They say the baron dyes his beard. I believe it.
A dragon was seen over the pass. Or a large goose.

dwarf: Another! The first one was practice.
Same again! Me throat's just warmin' up.
halfling: The stew was a warm-up. Bring the cakes!

goblin: Whoops, coins slipped. That's all of them, honest.
Exact change! Do not count it.

default: Brr... did it just get cold in here?
Why do I smell wet soil?
